ops.oldText: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
ops.newText: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the twelve (12) month period commencing on the Effective Date, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products, and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet. The Company's obligations under this Section 6.1, and HDI's exclusive right under this Section 6.1, shall terminate automatically upon (i) HDI's failure to have the Site fully operational within the period specified in Section 1.6, or (ii) any failure by HDI to perform its material obligations under Sections 1 or 5 (including any failure to keep the Site operational and accessible) that remains uncured thirty (30) days after written notice from the Company.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have limited our exclusivity to Deerskin Products for the first twelve months and made it fall away automatically if HDI misses the launch date or fails to keep the Site operational, since our playbook does not permit an open-ended sole-supplier lock-in with no performance-based exit. HDI's own exclusivity and non-compete in Sections 6.1 and 6.3 are unaffected.
input.summary: Narrow Company exclusivity in Section 6.1 to Deerskin Products, cap at 12 months, and add automatic termination on HDI performance failure.
